findings: Prototype cfac746 reproduced incomplete map precache and unscoped activation deletion. Its real UI wrote globe.display.v4.
Legacy → RC retained actual display preferences and old cache, isolated sibling caches, and prepared all core resources even with HD texture failures.
Core eviction changed the status, and retry restored completeness. Offline reload used the full RC snapshot.
HTTP 503, a disconnected resource request, and the wrong world-data integrity rejected the update. The active RC snapshot still loaded.
An overridden real browser quota rejected a partial install and kept the last usable cache.
Closing the browser during an incomplete installation left the old version available on a disconnected restart.
The waiting build could not take over while an older tab was open. Activation retired only the previous activated cache in this scope.
Closed and restarted Edge with network disabled and the origin unavailable. The PWA restored its full map and legacy display preferences.
The cached app opened Ming and the Canal observation and recovered its reading chapter on a second disconnected load.
